run_eval_realestate: run the evaluation script to predict new views on the RealEstate dataset and save output images
create_Dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset class that loads paired source-target images with camera poses from the RealEstate dataset
review_Dataset_getitem: review the Dataset __getitem__ method that loads images, parses intrinsics and poses, and builds camera projection matrices
test_Dataset_init: test the Dataset __init__ method that sets up image transforms, camera matrix K, and offset for habitat compatibility
refactor_eval_loop: refactor the main evaluation loop to customize batch size, output folder, or image saving logic
